statements.text: EGFR to MAPK1, shortest directed route in KEGG hsa04010 (MAPK signaling pathway): EGFR/CSF1R/EPHA2 (+22) -[binding, undirected]-> GRB2 -[binding, undirected]-> SOS1/SOS2 -[activation]-> RRAS2/MRAS/HRAS (+3) -[activation]-> BRAF -[phosphorylation]-> MAP2K2 -[phosphorylation]-> MAPK1/MAPK3 (8 equally short routes; all are drawn). Each step is a KEGG-drawn relation; a route is a curated summary and may skip intermediates.
